source.title: Some Open Problems Related to Quantum Computing

trace.notes: Normalized the original input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL. Local curl to api.zbmath.org failed because the Codex sandbox could not resolve external hosts, and the web reader did not expose readable technical text from https://zbmath.org/1652457.

failure_mode=metadata_only. Local resolver metadata in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv matched zbMATH id 1652457 to the title 'Some open problems related to quantum computing', year 2001, and links=nan. DBLP exact-title metadata matched Mika Hirvensalo, 'Some Open Problems Related to Quantum Computing,' Bull. EATCS 74:154-170 (2001).

Bounded exact-work recovery searched for the exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus 2001, and exact title plus World Scientific. Inspected candidates included DBLP author and volume pages, the author's publication list, ResearchGate profile metadata, and a bookstore/table-of-contents page for the later 2004 chapter. These candidates were rejected because they were bibliographic metadata, abstracts, tables of contents, blocked/non-readable profile pages, or a different later source rather than a readable full-text artifact for the exact 2001 zbMATH source.

No questions were accepted because no readable PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered. The source adequacy gate forbids extraction from metadata, abstracts, search snippets, tables of contents, or related later editions.
Saved exact JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1652457.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
